note: Synthetic upload bodies of a phone that registers, refreshes and unregisters its push device through the sync upload: what SyncPushDevices (packages/bond_notify_powersync) queues, one {user, body} per request. The id is d_ + the first 32 hex of sha256('<userId>|<deviceId>'). Tokens are obviously fake. The patch carries only the changed column (a token refresh on the same environment and topic). packages/bond_notify_powersync/test/legacy_upload_test.dart asserts the phone queues exactly these ops; services/legacy_host replays them.
